provenance.what: Independent reproduction of first-live-run.json, from an empty data directory.
provenance.why: The site quotes those figures. A number nobody has reproduced is a number nobody has checked.
provenance.model: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, Q4_K_M, via llama-cpp-python 0.3.35 on 4 CPU cores, 8192-token window
provenance.corpus: evals/corpus/aveline minus archive/ - 10 documents across Markdown, Word, Excel and PDF
provenance.golden_set: evals/golden-aveline - 26 cases, 17 answerable, 9 must-refuse, 37 wrong-answer guards
provenance.differences_from_the_first_run: Fresh data directory, so no pin and no cached answer could carry a case; drafting at ingest disabled, so every answerable case went to the model.
provenance.result: Every field identical to first-live-run.json, including the tier split.
provenance.throughput: About 57 prompt tokens/s and 6 generated tokens/s; 15-22s per answered question.
provenance.not_evidence_of: accuracy on real documents. The corpus and the questions were written together, which is the circularity that makes a benchmark flattering. It shows the pipeline behaves, and now that it behaves the same way twice.
provenance.reproduce: docs/TEST-RUN.md, appendix: running the local tier with no Ollama
